title: Convention frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a convention document under definitions/conventions/<topic>/. It is the machine-readable catalog of the convention's requirements; the Markdown body below it explains each one under a '### <ID>' heading.

title.description: The convention's title, in sentence case.

summary.description: One or two sentences stating what the convention asks for.

status.description: Lifecycle of the document. draft: under discussion; active: in force; deprecated: being replaced; retired: kept only so its IDs stay resolvable.

topic.description: The definitions/conventions/ subdirectory the document lives in, e.g. github-actions.

applies_to.description: Which files in a consuming repository the convention governs.

owners.description: Who reviews changes to this convention.

authority.description: Who decides what this convention says. 'self' means this repository is the authority. An object names the repository that owns the decision and where it is recorded; this repository then mirrors or proposes, and never contradicts it.

ref.description: Where in that repository the decision is recorded: a URL, or a path or ref within it.

migration.description: How this copy relates to the authority. proposed: drafted here, not yet adopted upstream; mirrored: tracks an upstream authority; authoritative: this repository is the source of truth.

implementations.description: Existing checks elsewhere that enforce this convention today.

check.description: The check's identifier in that repository, e.g. CI-14.

mode.description: blocking: fails that repository's build; warning: reported without failing; review: enforced by reviewers only.

references.description: External reading that supports the convention.

requirements.description: Every requirement the convention has ever held, retired ones included, in ID order.

title.description: The requirement stated as one declarative sentence; repeated in bold under its heading.

severity.description: Default severity of a finding. A convention profile may raise it, never lower it.

since.description: The release that introduced the requirement.

aliases.description: Identifiers this requirement had elsewhere, as <repository-short-name>:<id>, e.g. platform:CI-14.

replaced_by.description: Requirements that take over from a retired one. Required once the status is retired.

validation.description: How the requirement is checked. conftest: a Rego package in this bundle; jsonschema: a schema in this bundle; vale: a Vale style; delegated: an external tool the consumer runs; review: judged by a reviewer, not a machine.

package.description: The Rego package that emits findings for this requirement.

schema.description: Path of the JSON Schema, relative to the product directory.

style.description: The Vale rule, as <Style>.<Rule>, e.g. MusherConventions.Terms.

tool.description: The external tool or tools that perform the check.

check.description: The invocation or rule set that must pass.
